helpers.name: init
helpers.summary: Create or resume explicit local setup through the bootstrap CLI workflow.
helpers.use_when: You need connection context and workspace setup before beginning the first ticket.

helpers.effect: Offline read; saved attempts prove neither transmission nor commit.
helpers.name: journal.inspect
helpers.summary: Inspect one exact saved request's identity, hashes and receipt namespace offline.
helpers.use_when: You need to understand a saved attempt before choosing an exact retry.

helpers.effect: Offline read; scan completeness and commit status remain explicit.
helpers.name: journal.list
helpers.summary: List a bounded nonrecursive directory of saved requests and group matching or conflicting identities.
helpers.use_when: You need to audit saved attempts without contacting the daemon or replaying writes.

helpers.effect: Offline local filesystem write; preserves the source and publishes a new destination. Old registry jobs and saved API envelopes are not migrated.
helpers.name: migrate
helpers.summary: Convert a stopped supported older workspace into a verified new root.
helpers.use_when: You are upgrading from the supported 0.6.2-era format and need to retain planning, resources and history. Read migration instructions before acting.

helpers.effect: Local read traversal guidance; incomplete limits stay explicit and notifications are never acknowledged.
helpers.name: pagination
helpers.summary: Explain bounded local traversal, independent captures and resumable continuation requests.
helpers.use_when: A supported list must be read beyond one page without silently refreshing its capture.

helpers.effect: Offline reference; no request is transmitted.
helpers.name: receipts
helpers.summary: Explain method-specific durable results, revisions and exact retry handling.
helpers.use_when: A script must extract actual output fields without confusing counter namespaces.

helpers.effect: Local read helper; no daemon method or persistent worker.
helpers.name: request.wait
helpers.summary: Poll one request locally until a complete resolved observation or a bounded stop.
helpers.use_when: You need to wait for an accountable answer without asking again or acknowledging delivery.

helpers.effect: Local acquisition workflow; grants remain logical and uncertain writes keep exact identity.
helpers.name: reservation.paths.wait
helpers.summary: Run bounded foreground retries for an atomic logical path acquisition after typed contention.
helpers.use_when: A cooperating run must wait for overlapping file scopes without splitting its requested batch.

helpers.effect: Local acquisition workflow; no fairness queue, renewal or process supervision.
helpers.name: reservation.wait
helpers.summary: Run bounded foreground retries for an atomic named-resource acquisition after typed contention.
helpers.use_when: A cooperating run must wait for a shared database or other named resource, preserving exact uncertain requests.

helpers.effect: Local filesystem write plus daemon reads; stdout streams can precede a later integrity error unless spooled.
helpers.name: resource.download
helpers.summary: Download an immutable version with verified chunks and complete digest into a fresh destination.
helpers.use_when: You need exact resource bytes as a local file or a deliberately selected byte stream.

helpers.effect: Local helper expands one saved transaction.apply; publication is not approval.
helpers.name: resource.publish_text
helpers.summary: Atomically publish small immutable text and attach it to a ticket.
helpers.use_when: A new note or artifact must appear on its ticket in the same durable transaction.

helpers.effect: Local staged-upload workflow; optional ticket link is separate from publication.
helpers.name: resource.upload
helpers.summary: Upload a bounded local file as immutable content through an exact saved upload plan.
helpers.use_when: A binary or large text artifact must be published beyond the small-text limit.

helpers.effect: Local write workflow; published content and exact finish receipts remain.
helpers.name: resource.upload-abort
helpers.summary: Abort the owner staging identified by an exact saved upload plan without reading its source file.
helpers.use_when: An abandoned saved upload should free staging without deleting published bytes or receipts.

helpers.effect: Local replay workflow; saved bytes and original guards remain exact, and evidence commands never rerun.
helpers.name: retry
helpers.summary: Replay an exact saved request or supported upload plan without changing identity or attribution.
helpers.use_when: A transmitted write's outcome is uncertain and must be recovered without issuing a new intention.

helpers.effect: Local service process; preserve managed roots, locks and occupied sockets.
helpers.name: serve
helpers.summary: Run the standalone local daemon with its explicit registry directory and socket.
helpers.use_when: You need to start the state service in a separate harness-owned process.

helpers.effect: Local helper expands one saved transaction.apply; no new daemon method.
helpers.name: template.publish
helpers.summary: Canonicalize a small graph specification and atomically publish its resource and template registration.
helpers.use_when: You want a repeatable work recipe without manually calculating its exact content pin.

workflows.name: workflow.ask_question
search_terms: Ask and resolve an accountable question
steps: Save request.ask with explicit recipients, resolver_id and body; select a new topic or an existing thread with its actual expected_thread_revision.
Retain the returned request_id, request_revision and exact question reference; request.ask does not return a generic revision or status.
The designated resolver reads request.get, retains its current revision and saves request.resolve with that expected_revision and an optional nonblank answer body.
Read request.get or use the bounded local request.wait helper; inspect status.kind and the exact pinned answer, including a resolved request with answer:null.
Process inbox delivery separately and acknowledge only the selected handled notifications with inbox.ack; resolution never completes the linked ticket.
workflows.summary: Create a pinned question, receive its exact answer and keep delivery acknowledgement separate.
workflows.use_when: A participant needs an answer from a designated resolver and must retain its provenance.

workflows.name: workflow.backup_restore
search_terms: Export, verify and restore a workspace
steps: Read daemon.health and workspace.list; choose a fresh absolute export destination outside managed roots with an existing parent.
Save workspace.export and retain the actual export job ID and captured heads; writes may continue while that immutable capture materializes.
Poll export.get until a terminal status and use export.verify on the published complete workspace export; admission is not proof of completed publication.
Save workspace.restore for a fresh private root in a registry where the exported workspace identity is absent. Preserve the old data while verification and replay run.
Inspect the durable restore receipt, then explicitly workspace.open because restore registers the new root closed. Read workspace.overview and exact retained sources before new work.
For a direct portable-tree handoff instead, finish exports and workspace.close before the harness copies or transfers it; maintain one writer at a time and verify ancestry on register/open.
workflows.summary: Create an immutable portable backup and restore it into a fresh root with explicit lifecycle checks.
workflows.use_when: A local workspace must be backed up, transferred or recovered through its supported portable format.

workflows.name: workflow.import_history
search_terms: Import and retrieve visible conversation history
steps: Inspect the source format and select only user-visible messages and tool results. Never invent missing messages, import private reasoning, or treat recorded claims as verification.

Read references/history.md and the bundled scripts/history-adapter.py --help. The optional scripts/transcript-converter.py supports selected Claude JSONL records, not arbitrary role/content JSONL; inspect its --help and input requirements before use. These are Python scripts in the skill folder, not daemon API methods.

Create a session with session.create. Convert each event to a stable client_id, exact payload bytes and deliberately selected searchable_text; preserve source provenance. Append with session.append or the adapter, saving exact retry identities. Only durable acknowledgements permit discarding another copy.
Use history.search for selected text, retaining the returned history capture and event reference. Follow bounded continuation metadata before assuming the search was complete.

Use history.get and history.payload to retrieve the exact selected message or tool bytes at that capture. Check offsets, omitted content and payload hashes; planning workspace revisions are not history captures.
workflows.summary: Convert selected visible transcript events, save exact bytes, and find them later under a fixed history capture.
workflows.use_when: You have a conversation or tool transcript to import, search and retrieve without loading the whole history.

workflows.name: workflow.observe_changes
search_terms: Catch up and wait without losing a wakeup
steps: Choose the source: attention for a worker's filtered wakeups, changes for complete commit metadata, or inbox for addressed notifications.
Read the first bounded capture and retain its exact cursor and filters; inspect omissions and next-position metadata before treating coverage as complete.
Continue the same capture without substituting workspace, query, history or notification counters. An oversized next row requires a larger budget at the unchanged position.
After inspecting current readiness or notifications, wait from the retained source position using attention.wait, changes.wait or inbox.wait; a timeout creates no acknowledgement or ownership.
The harness decides whether to act or park again. Acknowledge only selected handled inbox entries explicitly and acquire work through the actual guarded mutation.
workflows.summary: Use bounded captures and exact continuation positions before parking a worker in a filtered wait.
workflows.use_when: A consumer must follow relevant changes or notifications while avoiding repeated acquisition writes.

workflows.name: workflow.plan_work
steps: Inspect project.get and status.list; read existing entity and policy revisions instead of guessing guards.
Draft transaction.apply operations for ticket creation, dependency.add and any required allocation.ticket_policy_put; use typed creation aliases within the plan.
Call transaction.preflight with the proposed operations and inspect blockers; preflight reserves no state.
Save and submit transaction.apply using one stable mutation identity; retain its actual IDs, revisions and durable receipt before the harness dispatches workers.
workflows.summary: Prepare tickets, prerequisites and admission policy together before dispatching workers.
workflows.use_when: A delivery goal needs multiple related work items whose dependencies and gates must publish consistently.

workflows.name: workflow.recover_work
steps: Read ticket.resume and actor.overview or coordinator.overview to recover recorded instructions, handoff, held claims and attempts. Stale observations and expiry never prove process termination.
For an uncertain write inspect the saved journal and use retry on the exact saved request; do not refresh guards or replace its mutation identity.
The harness must stop or isolate the old execution and checkout before reclaiming its logical ownership.
Read current ticket.context or reservation ownership and retain the exact old token, lease revision and other required recovery guards.

Save ticket.recover with explicit disposition:requeue when work should return to Todo, or use the exact named/path reservation recovery method. Read retained recovery audit before starting replacement work.
workflows.summary: Inspect retained work and exact saved requests before any guarded ownership recovery.
workflows.use_when: An invocation ended or became stale and another harness must decide how to resume safely.

workflows.name: workflow.share_context
steps: Use fact.keys or resource.list to discover existing context before creating a duplicate record; expand only selected values or metadata.
For small JSON values read fact.get and use its actual fact revision with fact.put; JSON null is a value rather than deletion.
For small UTF-8 text use resource.put_text with the resource metadata guard, or the local resource.publish_text helper when a new ticket link must publish atomically.
For large or binary bytes use the local resource.upload saved plan; ticket linking in that helper is separate and can require exact recovery.
Retain the returned immutable content version and digest independently of metadata revision; retrieve exact content through resource.read, resource.read_text or verified resource.download.
workflows.summary: Choose bounded facts or versioned resources and carry exact evidence pins into later work.
workflows.use_when: Agents need to share structured context, longer notes or binary artifacts durably.

workflows.name: workflow.verify_outputs
search_terms: Capture evidence and accept reviewed outputs
steps: Read the effective acceptance policy and review requirements before running checks; retain the observed policy digest and current claim and attempt binding.
Run the actual command through the harness, optionally using local evidence-run; inspect its observed outcome, truncation and declared source coverage before publishing with evidence-publish.
Publish the contract and manifest with exact resource versions and digests; retain the returned manifest revision, then submit it through review.submit as a new generation.
Record validation.add against the exact manifest and observed policy digest. A distinct configured reviewer inspects those exact outputs and records review.record for the actual generation.
Inspect review.gate; an approve message alone does not establish acceptance. Resolve changes requests explicitly, resubmit changed outputs as a new generation, and obtain fresh proof.

For each required acceptance criterion, perform the stated check and record acceptance.assert with its current effective policy digest, exact evidence pins and actual ownership guards. Validation and reviewer verdicts do not replace these assertions.

When the current generation passes review.gate, save review.accept under the observed submission revision. Inspect ticket.readiness for all remaining completion requirements, then ticket.finish under actual ownership.
workflows.summary: Publish exact output evidence, obtain formal checks and review, then accept and finish the current generation.
workflows.use_when: Completed work must satisfy reproducible validation and independent review requirements.

workflows.name: workflow.work_ticket
search_terms: Start, report and finish a ticket
steps: The harness provisions and supervises the process and checkout; register that actual invocation with run.register and retain its run revision.
Read ticket.context and ticket.readiness with target_run_id; inspect instructions, amendments, path ownership and policy before acquiring work.
Save ticket.start for the chosen ticket, or ticket.claim_next for selection, with the actual target run and an attempt ID when recording a try. Inspect the returned kind before using any token.
Retain the returned ticket token and attempt/lease revisions; record ticket.progress and handoff.set under current ownership, renewing timed ownership explicitly when needed.
Run the actual work and checks through the harness, satisfy applicable gates, then save ticket.finish with the actual token and concrete evidence. Report only observed completion.
workflows.summary: Record a real invocation, acquire admitted work and retain its actual ownership token through completion.
workflows.use_when: A harness has provisioned a worker that needs a durable ticket execution loop.

capabilities.summary: Define exact requirements, publish pinned outputs and record checks, review, acceptance and input reconciliation.
capabilities.title: Verify and accept evidence

capabilities.summary: Inspect recorded changes, attention, search and reported usage through bounded captures and resumable waits.
capabilities.title: Observe and wait
